guards.rule: Invitation is not consent or enrollment authority. EB01 locks current device/inventory scope and records candidate digest, expiry, server issuer identity. Secret is high-entropy bearer rendezvous only, stored as verifier hash, never audit/outbox/raw URL logs. EB02 rate limits and authenticates recipient; accountId always from verified primary session.

EB02 challenge binds invitation/device/current epoch/gate/binding/candidate/inventory scope/recipient account/holder thumbprint/session/consent text+digest/expiry. Multiple pending challenges confer no winner; first fully verified EB03 claims invitation atomically, competing recipient rejected. No gate/admission reservation on mere invitation or challenge issuance.

Device server root and app device trust resolve authenticated registry/provisioning lineage, not key supplied by peer. EBB01 validates server-signed ticket and holder key thumbprint+proof, replies with fresh device/client nonces and authenticated ephemeral key. EBB02 same live session validates holder consent proof over exact ticket/hello/nonces/account/device/text; physical device confirmation binds same digest. Selected profile must define channel key agreement, transcript canonicalization and displayed confirmation; unsupported profile denies.

EB03 current exact recipient session + valid holder signature + device trusted identity, physical proof, current revisions and expiry required. Coherent context/digests/nonces across statement, ticket, hello, device approval mandatory; schema alone does not enforce this. Consent materialized only after full verification, one consumed challenge and one claimed invitation under shared gate.

API045 delta adds missing enrollmentProofRef. Server resolves both refs to same current consent/invitation/recipient/holder/session/device/candidate and proof registry; caller-supplied holder/session values only equality assertions. Atomically consume both refs and invitation with one admission/basis/rental reservation under same locks; different idempotency key cannot allocate again. Same business retry returns original reservation after current auth.

EB05 can revoke only before admission reservation. Revoke and API045 serialize on same invitation/device/authority gates. After consumed return conflict + original admission, never clear reservation. If revoked/stale before signature completion, no activation/delivery. GET requires exact relationship, returns no secret and no competing recipient details.

FG01 accepts only dedicated current provisioning verifier with fresh server-issued device challenge, trusted manufacturer/operator provisioning manifest, validated device identity, approved inventory and trusted non-rollback history watermark. Identifier references resolved server-side; no user-declared virgin flag. One genesis record per device, prior consumption/enrollment irrevocable. Incomplete provisioning trust/profile stays unverified/quarantined; concrete root enrollment and attestation profile still unselected.

Wallet disposition is read from trusted server configuration ledger and current device signed inventory. Unconfigured requires never configured in this binding, verified empty wallet/import staging, no unresolved wallet operation; NULL origin alone is not evidence. Any material/ever-configured/unknown forces configured lineage recovery or quarantine, never skips checks. Configuration/import/signing writers share current device/binding/configuration gate with inventory snapshot and reset commit.

Unconfigured return skips only nonexistent wallet backup/asset-drain checks. Still requires owner consent/physical approval, full data inventory/passkey/recording/session/receipt cleanup, selected erase profile and reset evidence, completion ACK and cleanup proof. Persist device identity and required journal/marker only by selected profile. RR-DEC-01 remains unresolved for new_travel wallets; no recovery policy inferred. No automatic export/delete of unrelated imported assets.

Pending response 202 is durable accepted work only, with typed parent/action/digest/business outcome and revision, not final device state. ready refers to one signer/verifier subtask; read actual parent outcome before UI success. Work target signed bytes never returned by generic LW01. resultRouteId is server enum from route mapping, never arbitrary URL; original route current ACL handles result.

LW01 authorization follows persisted exact parent kind/action, not a client-provided selector or workId possession; current relay authority + sender proof is allowed only for original relay actions, never reset execution/admission permits. GET consumes only auth anti-replay metadata if needed. Revoked/expired parent rights deny old cached outcomes; no API020 generic fallback. LW01 relay authorityId resolves immutable server-verified authority, signature/profile/state/expiry/current revision and registered holder public key; sender proof binds GET, exact path/workId, contract version, authorityId and freshness nonce. No authority-ID possession authentication; unknown/missing stored authority denies.

Each parent/action has a durable work lineage and same immutable payload. Child signer/verifier task IDs append under same outcome; retries do not recreate domain actions. Signer output-link and authority activation follow LST-T11; evidence pending/apply LST-T12 then exact apply unit. Current auth/revisions rechecked after slow work, orphan results quarantined, no auto sign/reset from polling.

Execution reservation makes grantBarrier reserved_irreversible before signing; RT01/GET ready cannot deliver after device prepare boot/session/freshness expired. Preserve barrier; blocked/support review, no auto cancel or new reset grant. Nonexecution challenge expiry before reservation can restart fresh challenge, never convert an existing admission into a new reservation.

WC01 binds current owner/rental/binding/epoch/configuration revision and expiry in signed challenge. WCB01 signs positive empty result only if protected inventory is complete and no key material, import staging or unresolved configuration operation; otherwise reports MATERIAL_PRESENT/STATE_UNKNOWN/unsupported. WC02 resolves current server history and verifies exact device challenge proof, records immutable inventory reference at configuration revision. API046 and reset commit recheck same revision under gate; never trust caller empty flag.

Ticket uses an enrollment bootstrap session identifier, not a current owner session. Device reboot/session loss invalidates pre-reservation handshake; after reservation use original admission recovery constraints. Session renewal/holder replacement after reservation requires separate explicit recovery design, not bearer permit replay.

After EB03 consent, EB04 may disclose minimal recipientAccountId/holder thumbprint/enrollment session and consent/proof references to the current invitation creator operator for exact API045 assertions. No pending/competing recipient identity is exposed; before consent recipientBinding is null. This disclosure is included in consent text; identity is not authentication. Signed tickets/proofs and invitation secret remain excluded from GET.
